name: 01-intro
text: Conference Management System. Run your academic conference in one place.

name: 02-home-conference
text: From a public home page listing every conference, to a full event page with dates, tracks, and a live programme.

name: 04-author-submits
text: Authors sign in, write an abstract, attach their paper, and submit - no email back and forth, just a tracked submission with its own code.

name: 05-reviewer-reviews
text: Reviewers see the paper, never the author's name, and submit a structured review in minutes.

name: 06-convenor-accepts
text: The convenor's dashboard surfaces exactly what needs attention - here, a reviewed paper ready for a decision.

name: 07-programme-schedule
text: Accepted papers get dropped straight into the programme grid, and the public page updates the moment it's published.

name: 08-register-checkin
text: Attendees register. Staff check them in.

name: 09-attendee-registers
text: Registering takes under a minute, and ends with a ticket - Q R code included.

name: 10-staff-checkin
text: At the door, staff search, tap check in, and the count updates live.

name: 11-certificates
text: Certificates, generated and released in one click.

name: 12-generate-certs
text: With a branded template already in place, the convenor generates certificates for every checked in attendee and releases them at once.

name: 13-download-cert
text: Attendees download a real P D F certificate straight from their portal.

name: 14-verify-revoke
text: Every certificate carries a Q R code that verifies it instantly - and if the convenor ever needs to revoke one, that shows up immediately too.

name: 15-super-admin
text: And across every conference, a platform dashboard keeps an eye on system health.

name: 16-outro
text: Conference Management System. Abstracts, reviews, programme, registration, certificates.
